name: anvilts
description: Repository-aware formal verification for concurrent systems using labelled transition systems.

interface.longDescription: Inspect concurrent code with Codex, confirm a finite abstraction with the user, then deterministically check deadlocks and safety properties with shortest counterexamples and SVG state graphs.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and verify a concurrency risk with AnviLTS.
Model this concurrent protocol and check it for deadlocks.
